context.why: Sixth story of FS-030. Accepted so far: US1 (which already moved the contributor's location to Organization.location as a PointField srid 4326 with its own geography index, rewrote RORTransform.import_location to set a point, and made as_geojson read the point), US3, US2, US4, US5. This story gives organizations their point-only location input (plan D3, D7): the approved prototype put it on OrganizationProfileForm (fairdm/contrib/contributors/forms/profile.py), in the existing 'Location' section after (city, country), labelled 'Coordinates', with help text 'Where the organization is based. Organizations added from ROR get the coordinates ROR publishes.', using LocationField(full=False) from fairdm/contrib/location/forms.py — WGS 84 only, latitude and longitude in any notation the sample input accepts, no reference system, elevation or uncertainty. The two forms in fairdm/contrib/contributors/forms/organization.py (OrganizationCreateForm and the older profile form) list 'location' too and must get the same point-only field (FR-010) rather than GeoDjango's default map widget. The organization overview's has_map already reads organization.location is not None. LocationFormMixin is for LocatedRecord models with elevation and uncertainty; for organizations use the point-only field directly (its cleaned value's point goes to Organization.location), without adding a second mechanism.
prior_decisions: D1: a location is a value on each record, never a shared row. No Location model, no get_or_create.
D2: Organization holds a plain point, a Person holds none. Contributor.location is removed.
D8: no data migration — existing Point data is not carried across.
D12: field names are location, location_elevation, location_uncertainty.

FR-009: a sample type shows the location input only when its registration's fields list location. The demo's RockSample registration is to list location (as the approved prototype did); WaterSample does not.

D3 (decisions): a measurement falls back to its sample's location only for a viewer who may open the sample (Sample.objects.visible_to(user)); for anyone else a measurement with no location of its own has none.
D16: location constraints are listed in each concrete model's own Meta (location_constraints()), not on LocatedRecord.Meta.
D2: an organization's point is entered in the same notations as a sample's coordinates, WGS 84 only; a person has no location and is placed at their primary affiliation's organization's point.
Do not build anything DataCite: that story is on hold.
